title: Amtrak PIDS hold: performance period ended while FRA closeout review remained pending
summary: Amtrak says the Passenger Information Display System program period ended March 31, 2026, while FRA closeout reporting remained in final stages and pending review with a stated May 31 target. Denominator: The PIDS program closeout package associated with the completed period of performance, kept separate from station count, system acceptance, uptime, coverage, and passenger-use results.
key_findings: Evidence stage: Closeout or performance hold.
